tagline: Your feeds, fetched on a schedule, readable anywhere.
description:
RSS Reader subscribes to RSS and Atom feeds and fetches them in the background on an interval you choose, from every five minutes to once a day. Articles are tracked read and unread, filterable by feed and by status, and open in a clean reader view with a link back to the original.

With the Premium DeepL integration turned on, every article gets a one-click Translate button, powered by the free DeepL Translator app. Each reader enters their own DeepL API key there, so translation always uses that reader's own quota rather than a single shared server key.

Your reading list can also be published as a public page.
capabilities: Subscribe to any RSS or Atom feed.
Background fetching every 5 minutes to 24 hours, run by the mvmOS scheduler.
Read/unread tracking, mark all read, and filtering by feed or status.
Reader view with a link to the original article.
Premium: one-click DeepL translate button on every article, using each reader's own DeepL API key.
Per-feed fetch status and last-fetched time, with errors surfaced.
Optional public reading list with its own URL.
Full translations of the app and its public reading list in all nine supported languages.

integrations.name: DeepL Translator
integrations.summary: The Translate button sends the article to the free DeepL Translator app, using the DeepL API key that reader entered there themselves — never a key shared across the whole server. Turning the integration off in Settings removes the button; the reader works exactly as before.
integrations.requires: Premium, and the free DeepL Translator app with each reader's own DeepL API key.
